confidence_policy.LOW_action: fallback: keep previous waveform, fallback=true recorded

fallback_policy: AI call failure OR LOW confidence -> keep previous waveform; never fabricate metrics; fallback flagged in trace
ber_model_version: log10(BER) with 1e-12 clip floor, models/metric_models_v2 (two-part model tested, not adopted)
metric_model_version: metric_models_v2 (RandomForest, phase-3 training; phase-4 studies found no justified retrain)

_doc.provenance: Selected on held-out validation scenarios I-L after sweeps restricted to tuning scenarios E-H. Final A-D scenarios untouched during all Phase-4 tuning.
_doc.switch_margin_acs: absolute predicted-ACS advantage required to switch (strict >), inherited from phases 1/3
_doc.switch_margin_rel: relative predicted-ACS advantage required to switch; either threshold suffices
_doc.min_dwell_frames: minimum frames between switches (inherited; sweep found no measurable effect on the tested configuration)
_doc.tau_low/tau_high: empirical 1/3 and 2/3 quantiles of the agreement score over tuning frames E-H; documented inputs, NOT claimed universally optimal
_doc.temporal_window: 0 = frame-only decisions retained (no temporal signal evidence; see Reports/phase4_policy_sweep.md stage 4)
